basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old software developer from Toronto, Canada, who recently got into gaming to unwind after work. I'm particularly fascinated by cooperative games that require strategy and teamwork. Outside of gaming, I enjoy editing videos using Kdenlive, which helps me document my travel adventures. I work from home, so I'm usually online during evenings and weekends. Currently single, I enjoy exploring new financial ventures like AquaGoatFinance in my free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science, I have a strong grasp of technology and digital tools. My interest in video editing came from a self-learning journey through online tutorials. I joined Reddit to learn about gaming communities and financial innovations.
